linkedin: Only 23% of 4,441 remote job listings show the pay. That's 1,000 listings with a disclosed salary or hourly rate; 3,441 stay silent. The takeaway: undisclosed pay doesn't automatically mean low wages—many employers expect candidates to negotiate.
